prompt: Create ONE original game sprite asset: a gigantic enemy flying dreadnought for a richly detailed 16-bit arcade vertical-scrolling shoot-em-up. True straight-down overhead view, nose points toward bottom of image. Transparent background, fully isolated, no shadow, no ground, no text, no lettering, no UI, no border. Broad angular flying fortress, not a real aircraft and not a copy of Raiden bosses. Silhouette: central heavy armored wedge with short forked nose, two huge offset rectangular engine nacelles mounted on swept trapezoid wings, twin smaller dorsal turbines, exposed teal reactor at center lower hull, four orange gun sockets at wing leading edges. Dark petrol blue and gunmetal plated armor, warm cream edge highlights, burnt brass machinery, narrow orange hazard stripes. Intricate individually readable chunky pixel clusters: panel seams, rivets, pipes, air intakes and cooling fins. Clearly hand-pixelled 16-bit/32-bit arcade sprite look, NOT photorealistic, NOT smooth vector. Broad width-to-height ratio approximately 1.5:1. Entire aircraft centered with 10 percent transparent margin on all sides, complete wing tips visible. Asset will be displayed at about 350x240 game pixels; keep silhouette and details crisp. Strong contrasting top highlights on wing edges and dark recesses. The central reactor and wing gun sockets should look like distinct attackable mechanisms.
